m: यस् cl. 4. P. (Dhātup. xxvi, 101) यस्यति (rarely यसति cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 71; Impv. -ययस्तु, RV.; Gr. also pf. ययास; aor. अयसत्; fut. यसिता, यसिष्यति; inf. यसितुम्; ind.p. यसित्वा, or यस्त्वा), to froth up, foam, RV. (cf. √ येष्); to heat or exert one's self, Car.; to strive after (dat.), Kāvyād. ii, 83 (v.l.) : Caus. यासयति (aor. अयीयसत्) Gr.: Desid. यियसिषति, ib. : Intens. यायस्यते, यायस्ति, ib. [Cf. Gk. ζέω &c.]
a: यस् — {c1c} {c4c} P. (यसति, यस्यति, यस्त) To strive, endeavour, labour, --Caus. (यासयति-ते) To put to trouble.

s: ir ya u yatane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰-para॰-aka॰-sew । ktvAvew .) ir, ayasat ayAsIt ayasIt । asmAt puzAditvAnnityaM Na ityanye । ya, prayasyati । krama klama ityAdinA kevalAt saMpUrvvAcca asmAt Syan vikalpAt yasati yasyati saMyasyati saMyasati । u, yasitvA yastvA । yatanaM yatnaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: yatne divA॰ pakze BvA॰ vA Syan para॰ aka॰ sew । yasyati yasati saMyasyati saMyasati anuyasyati । irit ayasat ayAsIt ayasIt । aya puzAdirityanye udit ktvA vew । yasitvA yastvA yastaH ।

m: यस्क m. N. of a man (pl. his descendants and a partic. school; cf. यास्क), Kāṭh.; ĀśvŚr. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 63).
यस्मात् ind. (abl. of 3. य, correlative of तस्मात्, ततस्, तद् &c.) from which, from which cause, since, as, because, Mn.; MBh. &c. that, in order that, R.
